questions.question: Which seats should I choose?
gaps: A complete current seat-by-seat sightline, obstruction and legroom survey is not established; no exact “best seat” is asserted.

questions.question: What will the visit really cost?
gaps: A final quote requires a specific screening, seat, ticket type, purchase channel and applicable extras. Published tariffs, memberships, hire fees and event prices are not interchangeable.

questions.question: Can I bring children or a baby?
gaps: Booster seats, pushchair storage, baby-changing facilities and a current sensory-session calendar are not fully documented. Film age classification is separate from the cinema’s ticket-age policy.

questions.question: When should I arrive, and when will I leave?
gaps: Exact trailer duration and finish time are not established. Event-specific play periods, intervals, introductions or discussions must not be generalized to ordinary screenings. Parking hours are not auditorium hours.

questions.question: What language will I hear and read?
gaps: Confirm audio language, subtitle language and accessibility features for the exact screening. Original audio does not necessarily mean English; ordinary subtitles do not establish captions for deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers.

questions.question: Can I bring food, water or luggage?
gaps: Outside-food sourcing, water exceptions, bag storage, current menus and local allergen controls are not all established. Policies below are operator statements, not legal conclusions.

questions.question: Can I comfortably access this particular sala?
gaps: A complete route and facility survey for every sala is not established. Check the room, lift limits, wheelchair/companion allocation, toilet route and required hearing/visual assistance.

questions.question: What if my plans change or something goes wrong?
gaps: Transfer rules, partial-refund exceptions and current response times are not fully documented. A published contact does not guarantee a refund or an immediate reply.

method: Answers use prior research plus official public FAQs and municipal event pages. Every broad question remains partial unless all its subparts can be established.
Chains, individual venues, rooms, museums and dated events retain separate scopes. No cinema availability is inferred from a chain format list.
Prices remain observations, not a computed checkout total. Venue-hire prices are excluded from film-visit cost answers.
No trailer-length assumption or exact ending time is generated. Historical sensory events are not advertised as upcoming.
No product is labelled allergen-free. Public allergen-resource links do not establish local food handling.
No seat reservation, purchase, contact message, browser automation or deployment occurred.
Follow-up keeps conflicting official price tables, shopping-centre facilities and dated festival services explicitly scoped. Generic page-open responses do not corroborate detailed search-index text.

all-girona-mobile.value: Online confirmation includes PDF/QR tickets; a phone display is accepted.

all-girona-bonus.value: Bono Cultural Joven accepted at the box office and online.

all-girona-transit.value: Operator lists Verdaguer L4/L5, Girona or Joanic L4, and buses 39, 47 and H8. Route listings are a source snapshot, not live service verification.

all-girona-discounts.value: Non-holiday Wednesday spectator discount and Club Cinemes Girona member rates are advertised; use the dated tariff records for amounts.

all-zumzeig-route.value: One building entrance and the cinema entrance are adapted; an accessible toilet is available.

all-zumzeig-positions.value: Wheelchair accommodation is listed at row 7 seat 3 and row 1 seats 1, 2, 8, 9 and 10. These are published locations, not six seats to add to the 73-seat total.

all-zumzeig-no-loop.value: The operator explicitly states that there is no induction loop.

all-zumzeig-subtitles.value: Films with accessible subtitles are identified individually in their programme entry; availability is not universal.

all-zumzeig-dogs.value: Documented guide dogs are admitted; drinking bowls are available. Door/furniture contrast is limited in some areas.

all-cccb-route.value: Ramps and lifts connect the venue. The entrance ramp has a 14% gradient; some routes require staff assistance.

all-cccb-toilets.value: Adapted toilets on floors −2, 3 and 4; two loan wheelchairs can be reserved.

all-cccb-parking.value: Two designated accessible parking bays are listed in front of the Montalegre entrance.

all-cccb-wheelchair.value: Auditori has two reserved wheelchair places. Other rooms are described as flat-floor chair layouts; no fixed wheelchair-space count is supplied for them.

all-cccb-loop.value: Portable induction loops can be requested at the ticket desk, preferably reserved with the booking; compatible hearing aids need the T setting.

all-cccb-lsc.value: Catalan sign-language interpretation is available for selected activities or by request; accessible subtitles depend on the event.

all-cccb-dogs.value: Guide dogs admitted with documentation. Braille, large-print and audiovisual exhibition resources should not be assumed to apply to every screening.

all-cccb-counter.value: Reception/ticket counters are reported at 1.10–1.20 m high, without a lowered accessible section.

all-macba-admission.value: Free exhibition admission for visitors with disabilities and one companion with supporting documentation; this does not establish admission to every film event.

all-macba-priority.value: Priority entry, ramps/lifts and rest seating or folding chairs are provided.

all-macba-toilets.value: Adapted toilets on floors 0 and 1; two loan wheelchairs are listed.

all-macba-loop.value: Induction loops are listed at reception. Auditorium loop coverage is not established by this page.

all-macba-visual.value: Magnifiers/monoculars, assistance-dog water bowls and app audio descriptions of artworks are listed; these are museum services.

all-macba-cognitive.value: Adapted cognitive-access visits are available; individual film-session provision is unverified.

all-calandria-seating.value: The published 2018 terms distinguish unnumbered cinema tickets from numbered live opera/ballet seats. Current session-specific exceptions were not checked.

all-calandria-refunds.value: Published terms reject ordinary exchanges/refunds; cinema-caused error or technical failure can be refunded within a stated maximum of 30 days.

all-calandria-online-age.value: The sales terms restrict online purchasing to adults with capacity to contract; this is not an admission age limit for films.

all-ocine-contact.value: Group contact published in the legal notice: info@ocine.es.

all-texas-access.value: The basement cinemas use a stairlift rated to 150 kg for the person and wheelchair, with no alternative route above that limit. The theatre has a separate alternative entrance. The hall/bar and adapted toilet are at street level.
all-texas-access.correction_note: The earlier summary wrongly restricted the 150 kg statement to the theatre; the same page explicitly states a separate cinema limit.

faq-cinesa-child.value: Tickets are required from age 3. Under-3s also need a ticket if occupying a seat. Babies may attend, but the adult must leave temporarily if the baby disturbs others.

faq-cinesa-companion.value: Cinesa states that all salas have wheelchair spaces and that adjoining seats can be bought preferentially for companions. Exact routes and positions still depend on the room.

faq-cinesa-scooters.value: Bicycles and scooters, including folding/non-electric models, are not admitted to the salas. Cinesa says it has no cinema storage for them; shopping-centre facilities must be checked separately.

faq-cinesa-lost.value: Contact customer service with the date, cinema, sala, screening, row/seat and object description. Customer service checks with the cinema and responds when it has an outcome.

faq-cinesa-recovery.value: For a missing booking email, use the official customer-service form with booking and payment-identification details requested there. No recovery or refund is automatically guaranteed.

faq-cinesa-glasses.value: 3D glasses are a separate purchase. Compatible existing glasses can be reused after staff confirmation; IMAX 3D needs its own type. Glasses can be purchased online or at the cinema.

faq-cinesa-pricing.value: Price depends on cinema, day and screening. The published FAQ says online tickets cost €1 less than in-person purchases; treat this as a published channel rule, with the selected-session quote controlling the actual total.

faq-cinesa-supplements.value: Published conditional supplements: iSense €2.50; IMAX €4; reclining IMAX €5; ScreenX €3; DBOX €4; Reclinable Plus €1.50; VIP €1.20. A 3D screening adds €1, excluding glasses. This list does not establish that every format exists at each venue or that all supplements combine.

faq-cinesa-seat-types.value: Booking maps identify VIP seats with V, DBOX motion seats in orange and VIP Beds as beds. Reclinable Plus is a distinct paid seat category. Check the actual sala map; chain branding does not identify its best seat.

faq-cinesa-allergens.value: Cinesa publishes bar-product ingredient/allergen information online and makes it available at its cinemas. The catalogue does not certify any product as allergen-free or establish local cross-contact controls.

faq-mooby-recovery.value: If tickets do not arrive, check spam, then request a resend at info@moobycinemas.com. Purchase-flow support chat operates Mon–Fri 15:00–20:00 and weekends 12:00–20:00.

faq-renoir-guest.value: Online ticket purchase does not require a registered account or Club membership.

faq-renoir-refunds.value: Published policy rejects ordinary cancellation, changes and refunds. Incidents are handled by head office, not the cinema: contacta@cinesrenoir.com or +34 91 334 21 77 during office hours.

faq-renoir-lost.value: Ask cinema staff during opening hours about a lost item; the operator says found objects are retained.

faq-renoir-renewal.value: Club Renoir renewals are manual, not automatic. Renewing before expiry carries remaining invitations into the renewed membership.

faq-renoir-invitations.value: Club invitations are redeemed at the box office; member discounts can be used on Pillalas online.

faq-renoir-programme.value: The usual weekly programme goes on sale on Wednesday for Friday–Thursday. Holidays and selected advance-sale films are exceptions.

faq-filmax-language.value: VOSE means original audio with Spanish subtitles; selected films also offer VOSI, original audio with English subtitles. Choose the exact advertised version for the screening.

faq-filmax-support.value: Ticket help by telephone or WhatsApp: +34 603 500 004, 16:30–23:00. Invoice requests: facturacion@cinesfilmax.com.

faq-filmoteca-unnumbered.value: Cinema tickets are unnumbered; buying earlier does not reserve a particular seat.

faq-filmoteca-late.value: No admission once the screening has begun.

faq-filmoteca-cutoff.value: Online ticket sales close one hour before the screening. The online per-person/session limit is ten tickets in the published terms.

faq-filmoteca-collection.value: Subscriber reservations must be collected at least 15 minutes before the screening; uncollected reservations may be released.

faq-filmoteca-boxoffice.value: Box office: Tue–Thu 10:00–21:00; Fri 10:00–14:00 and 15:30–21:00; Sat/Sun/holidays 15:30–21:00. These are box-office hours, not auditorium-door times.

faq-filmoteca-food.value: Eating and drinking are prohibited in the screening rooms. Bicycles, scooters and skateboards are not admitted to the building.

faq-filmoteca-parking.value: At Saba Illa Raval / Hotel Barceló Raval, Sant Rafael 15, ask Filmoteca box-office staff for a voucher and present it at the car park for the published 25% discount.

faq-filmoteca-refund.value: Ordinary ticket changes/refunds are refused. For online bookings, cancellation or programme change gives an invitation for another session; the terms separately allow a refund or invitation for cancelled box-office purchases, subject to their force-majeure clause.

faq-filmoteca-help.value: Ticket/assistance enquiries: filmoteca.taquilla@gencat.cat, +34 935 671 070. For special assistance after online purchase, include the booking locator in the request to the venue.

faq-filmoteca-mobile.value: Bring the booking confirmation printed or downloaded on your phone.

faq-filmoteca-family.value: Family-programme tickets: €2 for children and €3 for accompanying adults, with at most two adults at that reduced rate. This is a programme-specific tariff, not a free-infant policy.

faq-filmoteca-dogs.value: Assistance dogs are exempt from the published ban on animals.

faq-texas-late.value: For cinema screenings, staff decide whether late entry is possible. The theatre’s absolute no-late-entry rule is separate.

faq-texas-food.value: Food and drink are permitted in the cinemas. The FAQ does not explicitly settle outside-food sourcing; its water-only restriction concerns the theatre.

faq-texas-storage.value: There is no cloakroom. Staff may exceptionally hold bulky objects that cannot safely enter the room, without accepting responsibility.

faq-texas-recovery.value: Staff can reprint a lost ticket at the box office or resend it by email after locating the purchase.

faq-texas-transfer.value: Tickets may be bought for another person; any discounted attendee must show their own eligibility. Phone-displayed tickets are accepted.

faq-texas-family.value: Family/children’s screenings are occasional; the venue says it has no fixed children’s-activity programme.

faq-kinepolis-child.value: Under-3s enter free only when they do not occupy a seat; occupying a seat requires a ticket.

faq-kinepolis-lost.value: Lost-property enquiries can be sent to info.espana@kinepolis.com.

faq-kinepolis-food.value: The Spanish chain FAQ says outside drinks/snacks may not be consumed in the cinema. This records the published policy; local exceptions and enforceability are not established.

faq-ocine-recovery.value: Use OCINE’s official ticket-recovery service for the cinema where the purchase was made. It offers purchase/payment identification methods; selecting the wrong cinema will not locate the booking.

faq-junior-admission.value: Sala Junior requires minors to attend with an adult, and adults to accompany a minor. It is not an adults-only screening option.

faq-junior-socks.value: Children must remove shoes and wear socks in the play areas. Published play-area age/height restrictions also apply.

faq-junior-timing.value: Sala Junior includes 15 minutes of supervised play at the start and a 15-minute interval. A film’s runtime alone therefore does not establish the visit length or exact finishing time.

faq-yelmo-allergens.value: An official allergen-table PDF is available. Its existence is recorded here; individual products, local stock and cross-contact conditions have not been assessed.

faq-cinebaix-versions.value: CineBaix labels DOC/DOE as dubbed Catalan/Spanish; VOC/VOE as original Catalan/Spanish; VOSC/VOSE as original audio with Catalan/Spanish subtitles. Read the individual screening’s label.

faq-catalunya-blue.value: A documented Hora Blava screening on 28 March 2026 used Sala 1 with ambient lighting, lower volume, no advertising, a quiet activity space and permitted breaks/re-entry; a pictogram guide and wheelchair platform lift were listed. This is a past event, not a verified upcoming schedule.

faq-cccb-family.value: Cinema 3/99’s Todo lo que baila lists free admission and CCCB Auditori sessions on 3–4 October and 12–13 December 2026. The 7–8 November screenings are explicitly at La Caldera, not CCCB.

faq-cccb-event-pricing.value: Activity admission is set on each event page. General exhibition tariffs and free Archivo Xcèntric appointments do not establish the price of a cinema screening.

visit2-castellet-route.value: The operator describes a ramp beside the stairs for access to the salas and an adapted toilet. Room-specific wheelchair positions and route dimensions are not published here.

visit2-castellet-relax.value: Cinema Relax uses reduced sound and partial lighting; movement, vocal responses and leaving/re-entering are permitted. A marked lobby area provides a break space. The advertised 27 June 2026 session is past; no upcoming date is established.

visit2-castellet-relax-conflict.value: The accessibility page quotes €6 with a disability card for Cinema Relax; the tariff page quotes €6.50. Neither is treated as the confirmed current charge.

visit2-castellet-under3.value: The tariff page says under-threes enter free; it does not specify whether this includes a separate seat.

visit2-castellet-promotions.value: Promotions are box-office only. The family offer requires at least two adults and two children under 13, Friday–Sunday/holidays. Birthday packs cover ages 6–12, minimum five children, with one day’s advance reservation.

visit2-magic-kids-play.value: The indexed KIDS page describes a slide and games, play before the film and a ten-minute mid-film break. Play equipment is closed while the film runs. The sala number is unverified.

visit2-magic-kids-birthday.value: The indexed birthday offer starts at €11.50 per child: admission, 90 g salted popcorn and 50 cl drink/water. Minimum ten children aged 3–13 plus an adult; the adult and applicable supplements are excluded. This age range describes the package, not general admission.

visit2-magic-price-conflict.value: Indexed tables on the same OCINE page disagree: Spanish weekday €8.50 versus Catalan €7.20; Friday/holiday €9.50 versus €8.20; spectator day Wednesday €6.90 versus Thursday €6.50. No definitive current base price or spectator day is established.

visit2-magic-companion.value: The indexed Spanish tariff offers a free companion admission at the cinema, excluding supplements, when the disability card explicitly establishes the need for accompaniment. Confirm its current application with the venue.

visit2-magic-baby.value: The shopping centre lists nursing rooms and baby-changing facilities in several areas. Their location inside the cinema and access after shop closing are not established.

visit2-magic-mall-access.value: The shopping centre advertises lifts, reserved parking and accessible toilets. This does not verify the route or wheelchair positions in each OCINE sala.

visit2-magic-parking.value: Shopping-centre parking allows three free hours per vehicle registration per day; longer stays are charged by the minute. Individual entrance hours differ; the FAQ gives 01:15 as the latest closing time.

visit2-magic-lost.value: For belongings lost in the shopping centre: +34 932 245 628 or info@magicbadalona.es. This is the mall service, not a verified cinema lost-property desk.

visit2-montcada-arrival.value: The operator estimates an eleven-minute walk from Montcada Ripollet station, and three minutes from the nearby Passeig Sant Jordi bus stops. Walking estimates are not a live route or rail-service check.

visit2-montcada-price-priority.value: The operator says prices displayed at the box office or purchase checkout take precedence over the website tariff table. Existing published price observations remain dated estimates.

visit2-santcugat-guest.value: Purchase terms allow checkout without an account and state that confirmation is sent by email.

visit2-santcugat-price.value: Purchase terms state that displayed prices include VAT. A base tariff and any separate service fees are not established by this page.

visit2-santcugat-refunds.value: The operator’s purchase terms reject refunds. This records the published policy, not a conclusion about statutory rights or cancellation exceptions.

visit2-capri-contact.value: The municipal venue page lists cinecaprielprat@gmail.com and phones +34 934 787 311 / +34 933 795 943.

visit2-caixa-nursing.value: CaixaForum Barcelona lists a nursing room. Baby admission and pushchair storage for individual film events are not specified.

visit2-caixa-mobility.value: Centre information lists accessible toilets, reserved Auditori spaces and loan wheelchairs at the lobby information point, subject to availability. It does not give wheelchair-position counts or event-specific allocation.

visit2-caixa-noise.value: Noise-reducing ear defenders for autistic visitors or people with sound sensitivity may be requested at reception. This is a centre service, not proof of a relaxed film session.

visit2-caixa-assistance-dogs.value: The centre permits guide and assistance dogs.

visit2-carol-access.value: The 2025 report lists a lift, entrance ramp, compliant room door widths and adaptable tables, plus ramp access to Plaça Farigola. It gives no measured widths, load limits or screening-room wheelchair allocation.

visit2-ifb-wheelchair.value: FIRE!! states that the Institut Francès screening room is wheelchair accessible. Route details, wheelchair counts and lift limits are not specified.

visit2-ifb-audiodescription.value: Mi vida en Versalles is listed for 21 November 2026 at 11:30, in Catalan with audio description. This is a specific Mi Primer Festival session; availability was not checked.

visit2-filmoteca-festival-captions.value: The festival lists its +10 short-film competition on 22 November 2026 at 17:00 in its deaf-access programme: hearing loop, descriptive subtitles, Catalan sign interpretation and live captions for presentations/discussions. Not a venue-wide guarantee.

visit2-girona-festival-audiodescription.value: Past example: Expedición en la jungla, 14 November 2026 at 17:00, was listed in Catalan with audio description. This does not establish a recurring service at every Girona screening.

visit2-cccb-festival-relaxed.value: Past examples: Pequeños experimentos animados (14 November, 12:00; no dialogue) and Crazy stop motion (15 November 2026, 12:00; VOSC) were listed as relaxed screenings, with ambient light, reduced sound, freedom to move and pictogram preparation guides.

tech3-girona-atmos.value: The operator confirms Dolby Atmos installation in Sala 3. This statement does not establish Atmos in Salas 1 or 2.
